title: Company admin
description: Your company's people, identity, audit and billing — what the server says you may manage here.

noSelection.title: Choose a company first
noSelection.description: The company admin area works inside a selected company and team. Pick one to continue.

refused.title: Nothing to manage here
refused.description: You hold no management capability in this company. Ask your company administrator if you need one.

unavailable.title: Company admin unavailable
unavailable.description: The company admin surface did not answer. Try again in a moment.

people.title: People
people.description: Every member of this company — nothing else. Actions submit to this company and are audited by the server.
people.refused: This company's people are managed by its administrators. You are not one of them.
people.failed: The roster could not be read.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: This company's connection and site-login credentials — masked by shape: the server's answer has no secret fields to show.
credentials.refused: Credentials are managed by this company's administrators.

identity.title: Identity providers
identity.description: This company's own SSO configuration and SCIM directory bindings — other companies' are not here by construction.

sso.title: SSO configuration
sso.none: No SSO configuration registered for this company.

identity.refused: Identity providers are managed by this company's administrators.

audit.title: Audit
audit.description: This company's business audit trail. The export obeys the same scope and masking, and the server records the export itself.
audit.empty: No audit events in this scope.
audit.exportDone: Export downloaded. The server recorded it in the audit trail.
audit.refused: The audit trail is open to this company's auditors and administrators only.
audit.failed: The audit trail could not be read.

enterprise.title: Enterprise settings
enterprise.description: This company's own configuration. Another company's selection answers refused, never displayed.
enterprise.refused: Enterprise settings are managed by this company's administrators.
enterprise.failed: The company configuration could not be read.

learning.title: Learning
learning.description: Research and demonstration records of the selected scope. Other scopes' containers never appear here.
learning.empty: No learning records in this scope.
learning.refused: Learning management is open to this company's administrators.
learning.failed: The learning records could not be read.

billing.title: Billing & usage
billing.description: The company books an explicitly authorized finance reader may see: balance, team usage and the usage lines that evidence them. Personal direct consumption is not part of this view.

books.noMapping: This company has no billing customer mapping yet — an honest empty ledger.

usage.title: Recent usage
usage.description: Read-only evidence from the company's usage records. Personal direct charges never appear here.
usage.empty: No usage records for this company.

billing.refused: The company books are open to an explicitly authorized finance reader only — being an administrator is not enough.
billing.failed: The company books could not be read.
billing.entryRefused: Billing management is open to explicitly authorized subjects only.

payments.title: Payment records
payments.description: The company account's payment records: amount, currency, collection, delivery and anomaly progress.
payments.empty: This company account has no payment records yet.
